topPRs.title: chore(ci): disable Go test coverage and Codecov uploads
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body: Go test coverage adds CPU/memory overhead in CI without being used as a gating signal. Drops `-coverprofile`/`-coverpkg` from the Go CI test recipes (main Go suite, fraud proofs, cannon, kona action tests) and removes the cannon and fraud-proofs Codecov uploads. Contracts (Solidity) coverage and its Codecov upload are unchanged.
